items.title: David Finck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 29, 2015
items.q: It sounded like a Giovanni Hidalgo conga solo to me. ... He’s great. He’s Puerto Rican and great, great conga player.

ctx.x: Yes, and I think you almost have to have grown up with that kind of music. So it’s not foreign. You’re not starting in a foreign place, it’s just a groove you understand.

And a lot of it comes from language. It’s interesting because I realize when I listen — on Paquito’s band when I’d listen to the Cuban guys speaking, sometimes I go you know that sounds like congas. They were like fast and loud and exciting. [scats] It sounded like a Giovanni Hidalgo conga solo to me.
What was that name you just said?
